title: Hisaab stored state (localStorage key hisaab-shop-v2), version 2.0.1.0
description: What the store (src/store/useShopStore.ts, Zustand with persist) writes under the localStorage key "hisaab-shop-v2" after every change. Only shop, customers, entries and shopUpi are stored; importError, statusMessage and lastDeleted stay in memory. No balance is stored: it is computed from the entries. Language and theme are stored under separate keys (hisaab-lang: en, hi or te; hisaab-theme: light or dark). On the first open, when this key is absent and the version 1 key hisaab.v1 holds a ledger, that ledger is converted and written here; the version 1 key is left as it was.

shop.description: Shop name shown under the app name. "" for a new ledger; set by an import ("Shop" when the file gives none).

shopUpi.description: The shop's UPI id typed in Settings, stored as typed; "" when not set. When empty (after trimming) the pay address in a reminder uses the demo id hisaab.demo@upi. An import does not change it.

customers.description: Customers in the order they were added or imported. Phones are unique.

entries.description: All entries of all customers. The page shows a customer's entries newest first: by date, then by id.

id.description: Made by newId() for a typed entry and by importIds() for an imported row (ids keep the order of the file); an entry carried over from version 1 keeps its id or gets v1-000000 and so on.

phone.description: The phone of the customer the entry belongs to.

type.description: credit adds to what is owed, payment takes away.

shot.description: Optional payment screenshot as a data URL. One chosen in the form is a JPEG fitted inside 600 px and aimed under 150,000 characters; an imported one is kept when it has at most 400,000 characters.
